name: Sinostone (Guangdong) Co., Ltd.
summary: Sinostone (Guangdong) Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production and sale of artificial quartz stone decorative materials. Its products include artificial quartz stone plates and artificial quartz stone countertops. The company also manufactures PVC and PPF materials for automotive interiors. Sinostone (Guangdong) was founded by Jun Zhou, Guo Qiang Hu and Hong Jie Jiang on March 27, 2007 and is headquartered in Foshan, China.
